actionable_sentences: The operation generates an appointment registration request for a hospital appointment.
It requires patient_name, date (in YYYY-MM-DD format), and doctor_name to create a new appointment.
lifted_nl: The API name used in the request must match 'AppointmentRegistration', with case-insensitive matching permitted.
The request must include exactly three parameters: patient_name (a string), date (a string formatted as YYYY-MM-DD), and doctor_name (a string).
operations.LABEL: FUNCTIONAL_SPEC
operations.Precondition: The user provides a non-empty patient_name string, a date string conforming to YYYY-MM-DD format, and a non-empty doctor_name string. All three parameters are present and non-empty.
operations.Function: AppointmentRegistration(patient_name: str, date: str, doctor_name: str) -> str
operations.Postcondition: Upon successful execution, the function returns an appointment_id string corresponding to the newly created appointment. The returned appointment_id is unique and identifies the registered appointment with the specified patient, date, and doctor.
assumptions: The user supplies a valid patient name (non-empty string)
The date value follows the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD
The doctor_name is a valid string identifier
The API service is operational and capable of processing the registration request
invariants: After registration completes successfully, the appointment exists with the exact patient_name, date, and doctor_name provided as inputs.
The returned appointment_id is a non-empty string representing the unique identifier of the newly created appointment.
